# Change

Describe the problem and resulting change.

## Evidence and decisions

Link research findings, pinned upstream references and relevant ADRs.
State whether conclusions are historical, proposed, source-verified or tested.

## Validation

- [ ] Repository checks passed, or the missing checks and reasons are explained.
- [ ] No historical claims are presented as independently verified without evidence.
- [ ] No raw archive, secrets, disc images or console dumps are included.
- [ ] Any implementation, device work or consequential action has separate authorisation.

Describe limitations and any decision needed from the maintainer.
